Role.description: A membership role. Canonical roles are `owner`, `admin`, `member`, and `guest`; a group MAY define additional roles via its `roles` catalogue.

RoleDefinition.description: A role a group defines (§5.2). Declares a role's name (and optional UI hints) so clients can offer it for assignment and render it, including custom roles beyond the canonical owner/admin/member/guest. A role's permissions are resolved from the group's `permissions` map, not from this object.

label.description: Optional human-readable display name; defaults to `name`.

color.description: Optional UI hint, e.g. a hex color for a role badge.

JoinPolicy.description: open = anyone may join; request = join requires approval; invite = invitation only.

GroupPermissions.description: Maps an action to the exact set of roles permitted to perform it. A role may perform an action iff it is listed for that action — there is no rank inheritance between roles. The owner implicitly holds every permission and is always allowed. Common actions: `post`, `moderate`, `manage`. Providers MAY define additional actions.

ChannelPermissions.description: Per-channel permission overrides (§5.2). Maps a channel action to the exact set of roles permitted to perform it, refining the group's `permissions`. Grant actions (`view`, `post:message`, `post:memo`, `post:article`, `react`) use exact membership: an actor is allowed iff their role is listed for the action (owner is always allowed); there is no rank inheritance. When an action is omitted the channel inherits the group equivalent (`post:*` and `react` fall back to group `post`; `view` falls back to the channel `tier`). `replyOnly` is a restriction, not a grant: an actor whose role is listed (owner exempt) may post only when the message carries a `reference` (i.e. is a reply). `replyOnlyTo`, when present, further constrains such replies so the referenced parent message's `type` must be one of the listed types.

replyOnlyTo.description: Parent message types a reply-restricted actor may reply to. Omitted = any type.

CallSummary.description: Lightweight, derived call status for a call channel — a read-time projection of the authoritative call state (§9.1), not an independently-stored value. Full signaling state is defined in §9.

Group.description: Canonical group object. Channels are not embedded; fetch them via GET /api/groups/{groupId}/channels.

roles.description: Optional catalogue of the roles this group defines, including custom roles beyond the canonical owner/admin/member/guest (§5.2). Absent = canonical roles only.

Invite.description: A join link / invite token granting membership to a group (optionally a specific channel).

channelId.description: Optional: invite targets a specific channel rather than the whole group.

token.description: The secret carried by the join link; redeemed at POST /api/invites/{token}/redeem.

grantsGuest.description: Whether this invite may be redeemed to provision a provider-local guest account (§4.8).

JoinRequest.description: A pending request to join a group whose joinPolicy is `request`.
